description: Where the user is in their 5-step trading routine today (shown on /routine): 1) weekly backtest of the setup (pairs that passed), 2) today's daily trading plan, 3) active price alerts on the plan's pairs, 4) today's MT5 orders checked for missing SL / off-plan / off-playbook pairs / over risk budget, 5) last weekly review. Each step has state done | warn | todo | idle and `nextStep` names what to do next. Call it at the start of a trading session and only propose trades on `steps.measure.passedSymbols` when that list is non-empty. Read-only. Requires a personal SocialForex API token. Create one at /mt5 (section "Connect an AI assistant (MCP)") and add it to the MCP client as header `Authorization: Bearer sfmcp_...`.
name: get_trading_routine
title: My trading routine progress
